title.narrative: Strengthen the implementation and promotion of the 2003 Convention for the Safeg

description.narrative:
As a signatory to the Convention for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage, this activity will enable Namibia to identify and define the various elements of intangible cultural heritage present in the country, with the participation of communities, groups, and relevant non-governmental organizations. The activity will also support the documentation of intangible cultural heritage present in the country.
The activity will further provide continued support towards the implementation of the safeguarding plan for Aixan/Gana/Ob#ANS TSI //Khasigu (Nama ancestral music), inscribed on the List of Intangible Cultural Heritage in Need of Urgent Safeguarding, as well as the documentation process of Okuruuo (Holy Fire), inscribed on the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.
In addition, the activity will continue to promote and raise awareness about intangible cultural heritage through education and youth involvement by supporting the participation of young people in the annual celebration of various intangible cultural heritage festivals, while incorporating aspects of innovation and technology. The activity will also support initiatives related to the documentation of intangible cultural heritage and assess how it is affected by disaster risks and climate change.
Key activities - Organize and strengthen the participation of youth in annual festivals of intangible cultural heritage. - Support toward initiatives related to the documentation of the Intangible Cultural Heritage led by the Ministry of Education, Innovation, Youth, Sport, Arts and Culture.
